posts.meta_description:
21K likes, 156 comments - bingingwithbabish on August 27, 2026: "Holy. Cats. When I first dreamt up this story 14 years ago, if you had told me that one day I’d actually direct it, with incredible actors & a massive crew of highly capable creatives, and that its announcement would be a @variety exclusive, I’d…probably have flipped the everloving fuck out, like I’m doing right now!!! Thank you so much to the incredible @lizakoshy @deanwintersofficial and Brandon Alan Smith for their gorgeous performances, to @furtheradventuresmedia for believing in this project and being incredible production partners, to the nearly 30 cast & crew that worked so hard to make it a reality, to @variety & @selomeee for the amazing article, and to YOU!! For supporting me over the years, watching my videos, and giving me the platform to even do something like this in the first place. I cannot wait to show you what we made. I’m literally editing it right now!!

Old Soul is about a body-hopping consciousness that wakes up in a new person every day - and has been doing so for millennia - who might have finally stumbled across a chance to connect with others in a meaningful way.

And yes, there’s food in it!

#shortfilm #indiefilm #alexa35 #panavision #nycproduction".
